scope: 38 newly recognized Special Energy components and fully supported additional cards; no previous supported program or metadata changes.

sources.title: Ignition Energy official competitive review
sources.checkedFacts: Ignition provides three Colorless on Evolution hosts, works on Rule Box Pokemon regardless of prize lead, and is discarded at its owners turn end.

sources.title: Triple Acceleration Energy
sources.checkedFacts: Evolution-only attachment and continuous discard on an ineligible host; three Colorless units; discard at the end of the turn.

sources.title: Counter Energy and Warp Energy official translated card list
sources.checkedFacts: Counter Energy needs more remaining prizes and a host other than GX or legacy EX; modern ex is a distinct marker. Warp requires this Energy itself to be attached from hand to the Active host.

sources.title: Single Strike Energy
sources.checkedFacts: Single Strike host restriction, one selectable Fighting or Darkness unit, and additional damage only to the opponents Active.

sources.title: Temple of Sinnoh official strategy
sources.checkedFacts: Special Energy override replaces provision with one Colorless and suppresses other Energy effects.

sources.title: Gift Energy official strategy
sources.checkedFacts: Gift Energy restores the hand to seven on the specified Knock Out. Full printed opponent attack damage requirement and any-position scope are retained from the local printing text.

sources.title: Advanced Player’s Rulebook 3.4
sources.checkedFacts: Physical Energy cards can provide several units; effect attachment differs from the manual attachment; damage, damage counters and attack effects are distinct. Opponent-only damage modifiers do not apply to own Pokemon.

boundaries: 38 complete Energy definitions, including reprints, are enabled; unresolved Energy clauses remain unsupported.
Automatic Energy effects are not Pokemon Abilities. Source-card identity, attachment origin and the stated host predicates are enforced independently.
Numeric damage modifiers with opponent_only retain owner relation per actual damaged Pokemon, for primary and composed damage; old data keeps its existing semantics.
Active-only boosts remain Active-only; Double Turbo applies to all opposing damaged Pokemon. Stone/Shield apply only to opposing attacks. Damage counters are unaffected.
Ignition discards at its owners turn end; Triple Acceleration uses either turn end and requires an Evolution host. Suppressed Energy effects do not self-discard.
Conditional Energy follows current host and remaining prizes; supplied units are never multiplied by interpreting selectable types as separate units.

Host/type restrictions are enforced before hand attachment and continuously after evolution or movement. A dual-type host satisfies either printed type; printed tags take precedence over a legacy single combat type.
No artwork, installation, client or GameTest changes.
